sources.entry: Eonvelope - Email archiving software that allows you to preserve your emails for an indefinite long period of time. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 K8S/Docker

summary.name: E∘nvelope
summary.one_liner: E∘nvelope is a self-hosted email archiving application that preserves emails, attachments and conversation threads from IMAP, POP, Exchange and JMAP accounts.
use_cases: Archive a mail folder or entire mail account automatically
Search and filter archived emails and attachments
Restore archived emails back to a mailbox
Connect archived email to other self-hosted apps
summary.what_it_does: E∘nvelope archives emails automatically from single folders or whole accounts, or fetches content manually, supporting IMAP, POP, Microsoft Exchange and JMAP. It stores emails, attachments and correspondents separately and reconstructs conversation threads. Users can filter, search and browse archived items through a mobile-friendly web frontend with dashboard, list/table and chronological views. Emails can be imported, exported in various formats, and restored to the original mail account. It integrates with self-hosted tools such as Paperless-ngx, Immich, Grafana and Searxng, and provides an API.
notable: Supports IMAP, POP, Microsoft Exchange and JMAP email protocols
Stores emails, attachments and correspondents separately and shows conversation threads
Slim two-container Docker stack with a slim mode for low-spec devices
Full API and integrations with Paperless-ngx, Immich, Grafana and Searxng
caveats: Requires self-hosting via Docker or Kubernetes; no hosted version is mentioned on the page
Restoring emails requires access to the mail account
